title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. brachypus
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. brachypus, commonly known as a type of Hawkweed, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. brachypus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium glaucinum subsp. brachypus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
